components.name: Gammon steak
components.note: The thick, grilled gammon provides the plate’s firm, meaty texture and pronounced savoury flavour with a salty tang.

components.name: Fried eggs
components.note: Choose two fried eggs for soft yolks that contrast with the firm gammon and keep the topping savoury.

components.name: Pineapple rings
components.note: The alternative topping brings charred sweetness and acidity, offering a sharper contrast to the gammon’s salty flavour.

components.name: Chips
components.note: A hearty portion of chips makes this a substantial plate alongside the thick gammon and your chosen topping.

components.name: Garden peas
components.note: Sweet garden peas provide another contrast to the salty meat and complete the plate alongside the chips.

taste:
This is a substantial, savoury plate built around thick gammon with a firm, meaty bite and a noticeable salty tang. Grilling gives the meat its cooked finish while retaining the juicy character described in the dish. Chips make the meal more filling, while sweet garden peas offer a contrast to the gammon rather than competing with its flavour.

Your topping choice makes the main difference to how it eats. Two fried eggs bring soft yolks against the firmer meat, keeping the combination predominantly savoury. Charred pineapple rings take it in a sweeter, more acidic direction, offsetting the saltiness. Served hot, it is a traditional, comforting dinner rather than a light meal.
value:
The typical {price} buys a complete plate with chips, peas and a choice of topping, making it worth considering for a substantial pub dinner. In our tracked [Steak Club](/steak-club) selection, it is {pricePosition}; local prices still vary.

Compare it with the eight ounce sirloin steak or five ounce rump steak if you prefer another cut, rather than choosing on price alone. Tuesday Steak Club pricing is relevant here, and participating pubs often include a drink. Check the local offer and eligible drinks before comparing the total with a standard meal order.

{name} is a meat dish, so it is not suitable for vegetarian or vegan diners. Our data lists mustard and sulphur dioxide as allergens, but provides no dietary tags confirming suitability for other requirements.

Anyone avoiding either listed allergen should check the current information with the pub before ordering. The egg topping also needs attention if you avoid eggs. Choosing pineapple instead is not enough to establish suitability: topping changes, other swaps and preparation arrangements can affect the allergen picture. Ask staff to check the complete meal, not just the gammon.

bestFor.title: Traditional pub dinners
bestFor.text: Choose this for a familiar, substantial dinner built around grilled meat, chips and peas. The salty gammon and simple topping choice suit diners who prefer straightforward pub food.

bestFor.title: Savoury egg fans
bestFor.text: The fried egg option suits diners who want a predominantly savoury plate, with soft yolks providing a clear texture contrast to the firm gammon.

bestFor.title: Sweet and salty tastes
bestFor.text: Pick the pineapple topping if you enjoy sweet and salty combinations. Its charred sweetness and acidity give the gammon a different balance from the fried egg option.
